According to WAI-ARIA APG, only left/right arrows should navigate between horizontal tabs.",

    const tabs = this._getTabs()
    const currentIndex = tabs.findIndex(tab => tab === document.activeElement)
    let nextIndex
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft':
        nextIndex = currentIndex - 1
        break
      case 'ArrowRight':
        nextIndex = currentIndex + 1
        break
      case 'ArrowUp':
        nextIndex = currentIndex - 1
        break
      case 'ArrowDown':
        nextIndex = currentIndex + 1
        break
      case 'Home':
        nextIndex = 0
        break
      case 'End':
        nextIndex = tabs.length - 1
        break
      default:
        return
    }
    event.preventDefault()
    this._activateTab(tabs[nextIndex])
  }",

    const tabs = this._getTabs()
    const currentIndex = tabs.findIndex(tab => tab === document.activeElement)
    let nextIndex
    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowLeft':
        nextIndex = currentIndex - 1
        break
      case 'ArrowRight':
        nextIndex = currentIndex + 1
        break
      case 'Home':
        nextIndex = 0
        break

        break
      default:

    this._activateTab(tabs[nextIndex])
  }"
    }

  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Pressing the down arrow on a horizontal tab no longer switches to the next tab, allowing the key to be used for scrolling or moving focus into the tab panel, consistent with ARIA APG keyboard navigation for horizontal tabs.",
  "functional_risks": [

    "Existing tests for vertical tabs might fail if they exist."

    "Test Home/End keys still navigate to first/last tab."
  ]
}
